sourceContract: animation-code-contract(5).md — Story Production & Animation Code Contract v1
statusPolicy: Only visually and structurally QA-approved STATIC poses may be Supported. All dynamic actions remain Partial until user approves; Studio runtime not tested.

engineCompatibility.preview: Offline pure-clock harness, NOT Studio GSAP runtime

api.overlapPolicy: Exclusive channels per actor. add() throws on time overlap for the same channel; adjacent actions may meet at exact boundary.
api.timePolicy: GSAP paused absolute clock; pure state evaluation at each time. No callbacks, timers, autonomous tweens or cross-scene state.
api.contactPolicy: For touch use pre-authored targetAngles and shared world transforms. Validate both contact anchors after transform; no IK/physics.

actions.limitations: No approved subtle idle keyframes; neutral in-plane prototype
Only front 12 expression states have independent eyelid groups

actions.description: Small head/neck motion; torso/arms remain rigid
actions.limitations: No rib-cage deformation; not a body-scale animation

actions.description: Approximate attention with head tilt only
actions.limitations: True eye gaze/yaw is unsupported; no invented three-quarter transition
Not a yaw turn; 3/4 views require separate approved pose

actions.description: Use an authored front facial state and gentle head lift
actions.limitations: Face switches by absolute time in seek; no callback; only front

actions.description: Use authored surprised face and lift head
actions.limitations: Face switches by absolute time in seek; only front

actions.description: Use authored sad face and lower/tilt head
actions.limitations: No procedural tears, only authored front sad expression

actions.description: Blend authored shoulder/elbow/wrist angles toward contact
actions.limitations: V4 reaching reference not bound to rig as approved animation; joint lengths fixed

actions.description: Finish authored contact keyframe, verify world anchors
actions.limitations: Exact anchor solve only for supplied V4 front pair and fixed grounded layout; no IK

actions.description: Withdraw hand along same authored joint trajectory
actions.limitations: Not shown in 8s scene; no automatic partner retreat

actions.description: Move actor root with bounded front-view leg/arm swing
actions.limitations: Approved walk-cycle reference is NOT rig-bound; front-view technical proxy only

actions.description: Fade out leg/arm gait while preserving actor x
actions.limitations: No step-specific planted-foot correction; static foot position restored

demo.sourceEnvironment: Rain SVG V3; SMIL transforms converted into deterministic absolute-time vector rain

notSupported: dynamic facial expressions in 3/4 or side views
